title: A --cascade's pointer and record ({plan}/<composite>/cascade-current.json, cascades/<stamp>-<id8>/record.json)
description: utils/improve_cascade.py writes both files, atomically, and checks every read of them against this schema with utils/schema_validator.py (the draft-07 subset the plugin carries, so no runtime dependency). A file that fails is exit 3 naming the file, like an unreadable state.json. The pointer names the current cascade of one composite (improve-plan or improve-code); each cascade keeps its own directory, and starting a new one never renames or reuses a path: the new directory and its record are written first, an unfinished predecessor is marked `abandoned`, then the pointer is replaced. The two documents are told apart by their keys; the definitions `pointer` and `record` are what each read checks. The prose contract is docs/development/workflows.md, 'A cascade (`--cascade`)'.

token.description: A random hex token: the cascade id, or a review round id.

stamp.description: A local ISO timestamp, or null when the event has not happened.

policy.description: A --scope-policy value, or null for none (each round resolves its own).

dir.description: The cascade's directory, relative to the composite's run dir: cascades/<YYYYmmddTHHMMSS>-<first 8 characters of cascade_id>.

counts.description: A closed stage's counts, as utils/cascade_archive.py computes them from the stage's published artifacts (stage_counts); null until the stage is closed. The archive owns the definitions; the types are pinned here.

held_back.description: Scope deferrals of the stage's review round (absent in counts recorded before the column).

model.description: The stage's one canonical provider:model spec.

state.description: pending until the stage's inputs are frozen and it is handed out; running from then; done once closed out (archived); skipped for a middle stage whose review produced no result.

bound_round.description: The review round id most recently seen carrying this stage's provenance block; binding only asks whether it is set.

scope_policy.description: The policy the stage started under.

skip_reason.description: Why a skipped stage was skipped: its model's failure reason.

scope_policy.description: The policy for stages not started yet: the typed --scope-policy at the start, or a later typed one.

selectors.description: improve-code's typed selectors, frozen at the start so a bare continuation reproduces them. Both null on improve-plan.

files_file.description: files.txt in the cascade's directory (one repository-relative path per line) when --files or --files-from <file> was typed; every stage's review gets --files-from with its absolute path.

base_ref.description: --base-ref as typed; every review and apply gets it.

finished_at.description: When the cascade finished or was abandoned.
